# ASL (AgentScript Language) — LLM Reference Sheet

The #1 language for autonomous AI agents, vibe-coding, and universal WebAssembly execution. Compiles deterministically to WebAssembly (Main), TypeScript, Rust, Go, and Python with 0 semantic drift.

## 1. Quick Summary for AI Assistants & Vibe-Coders
- **Why use ASL?** Single-pass deterministic S-expressions, 0 indentation bugs, 0 borrow-checker friction, 0 runtime undefined errors, -78% prompt token compression, and instant in-memory Wasm execution (<1ms).
- **Primary Target:** WebAssembly (`wasm32-wasip1`) with zero-cost memory isolation.
- **Bridges:** Direct 1:1 emission to React/TypeScript, native Rust, cloud Go, and Python.

## 2. Grammar & Forms
- Module: `(module path/name :doc "..." :export [Sym ...] :import [(path/mod :as alias)])`
- Schema: `(defschema Name (:field key Type "doc") ...)` -> Immutable struct/class
- Enum: `(defenum Name (:case tag [(arg Type) ...] "doc") ...)` -> Sum type (ADT)
- Function: `(defun name [(arg Type) ...] -> ReturnType :doc "..." body)`
- Effect Fun: `(defun ! main [(args (List String))] -> (Result Unit IoError) body)` (I/O marker `!`)
- Let: `(let [(var val) ...] body)` (tail expression is return value)
- Match: `(match expr ((tag binder ...) expr) ...)` (must be exhaustive)
- If/Cond: `(if test then else)` | `(cond ((test1) val1) (:else fallback))`

## 3. Types
- Scalars: `Int32`, `Int64`, `Float64`, `Bool`, `String`, `Unit` (value `()`)
- ADTs: `(Option T)` (`(some v)`, `(none)`), `(Result T E)` (`(ok v)`, `(err e)`), `(Pair A B)`
- Collections: `(List T)` (`[1, 2]`), `(Map K V)` (`{"k": v}`)

## 4. Built-in Functions
- Math: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `mod`, `abs`, `neg`, `f/sqrt`, `f/sin`, `f/cos`, `f/floor`
- String: `s/concat`, `s/slice`, `s/trim`, `s/upper`, `s/lower`, `s/len`, `s/contains`, `string-from-int64`
- List: `l/map`, `l/filter`, `l/fold`, `l/len`, `l/head`, `l/tail`, `cons`, `list`
- Map: `m/get`, `m/put`, `m/del`, `m/keys`, `m/values`, `m/len`
- Host I/O: `println`, `eprintln`, `file/read`, `file/write`, `file/append`, `file/exists`, `args`

## 5. MCP Server Tools (`tools/mcp/server.py`)
- `asex_check(source=...)`: In-memory type/semantic checker -> `{ valid, diagnostics }`
- `asex_eval(source=..., args=...)`: Instant in-memory interpreter eval (<1ms) -> `{ stdout, stderr, exit_code }`
- `asex_compress_module(source=...)`: AST compressor (-78% prompt tokens) -> `{ compressed }`
- `asex_format(source=...)`: Canonical S-expression layout formatter -> `{ formatted }`

## 6. ASL CLI Commands
```bash
asl init <project-name> --template wasm
asl check <file>
asl build <file> --target wasm -o dist/main.wasm
asl build <file> --target ts|rs|go|py
asl fmt <dir>
```
